prompt: What was David Fincher's most recently released feature film when Britney Spears' first feature film was released in the U.S.?
answer: David Fincher’s most recently released feature film at that time was **_Fight Club_ (1999)**. Britney Spears’s first feature-film appearance was in **_Longshot_**, released in the U.S. in 2001; Fincher’s next film, **_Panic Room_**, was not released until 2002.
